reason: The two are close on the script's delivery estimate (696.5 vs 719.3), but C11 has more major episodes (28, P76, vs 21, P47) and his majors sit in PostHog's core data platform rather than one young product line: the flag_evaluations migration (ws1, #110254 cutover, #124397 HogQL rewrite, #126076 flag removal) cuts storage for one of the highest-volume event types across analytics, experiments, cohorts and CDP, and he closed the privacy-deletion gap for the new table (#117395, #114276, registry plus CI test #82056). That broader system leverage also shows in downstream_authors 85 vs 66 and requested_by 12 vs 6. C01 is the cleaner engineer (first_pass_rate 1.0 vs C11's 0.961 at P5, trust_rank P95 vs P47) and C11's HogQL rewrite needed four follow-up major fixes, but C01's flagship rotation work (#86676) needed six follow-ups and 7 of his PRs were fixed by others, so quality does not outweigh the bigger difference in what was delivered.
